name: Merry and Bright Holiday of Lights at Poplar Grove
host: Poplar Grove Historic House and Museum
when_note: Select nights Nov 27 to Dec 22, 2026, 5 to 9 PM
paras: Poplar Grove Historic House and Museum in Wilmington runs Merry and Bright, A Holiday of Lights, on select nights from November 27 to December 22, 2026, from 5 to 9 PM. The first three weekends run Friday through Sunday, and the final week runs Friday through Tuesday.

Admission covers the lighted grounds, visits with Santa at the Gazebo, Grinch's Junk Shop, Bumble's Snowball Party and Santa's Boot Camp, plus campfires for marshmallows and outdoor holiday movies. A $10 ticket covers all ages with children 2 and under free, and a $35 family pass covers 2 adults and 2 children ages 2 to 11. Last call to enter Santa's line is 8:30 PM, and parents must supervise kids around the light sets.
tip: Santa's line closes at 8:30 PM, so arrive early in the evening.
